tasks.prompt: Fix src/counter.mjs so concurrent increments never lose updates and the persisted JSON remains valid. Do not edit verifier files.

files.src/counter.mjs:
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
export async function increment(path) { const value = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, 'utf8')); value.count += 1; await writeFile(path, JSON.stringify(value)); return value.count; }

import { resolve } from 'node:path';
export function resolveInside(root, input) { const target = resolve(root, input); if (!target.startsWith(resolve(root))) throw new Error('outside root'); return target; }
